fact: The government's National AI Strategy (SNIA), presented by the Minister of Posts and Telecommunications, plans a sovereign large language model, "GPT Cameroon", for local and national languages, with voice data collection.
ST Digital announced GPU Cloud Africa, with NVIDIA GPU servers to be deployed in Douala, to provide AI hosting from the second quarter of 2025.
The Direction Generale du Budget reports that GOV-AI runs only on local servers, hosted in Cameroon on CENADI's national infrastructure, and is available now through the nGomna app.

Researchers at the universities of Ngaoundere and Dschang and ESSCA report building a machine-learning tax fraud model for Cameroon, trained on 3.2 million records and piloted at three tax centres, per Business in Cameroon.
